---
title: "Sluggers"
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(Lahman)
```

```{r}
career_batting <- Batting |>
  group_by(playerID) |>
  summarize(
    career_home_runs = sum(HR, na.rm = TRUE),
    first_year = min(yearID, na.rm = TRUE),
    last_year = max(yearID, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(career_home_runs)) |>
  slice_head(n = 15) |>
  left_join(People, by = "playerID") |>
  mutate(
    player = paste(nameFirst, nameLast),
    seasons = paste(first_year, last_year, sep = "–"),
    steroid_era = if_else(
      last_year >= 1994 & first_year <= 2009,
      "Active during steroid era",
      "Not active during steroid era"
    )
  ) |>
  select(player, career_home_runs, seasons, steroid_era)

career_batting |>
  mutate(player = fct_reorder(player, career_home_runs)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = career_home_runs, y = player, fill = steroid_era)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Active during steroid era" = "#D55E00",
      "Not active during steroid era" = "gray55"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Career Home Run Leaders",
    subtitle = "Top 15 MLB players by career home runs",
    x = "Career home runs",
    y = NULL,
    fill = "Career overlap",
    caption = "Source: Lahman Baseball Database"
  )
```

```{r}
Batting |>
  filter(playerID == "bondsba01") |>
  group_by(yearID) |>
  summarize(home_runs = sum(HR, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = yearID, y = home_runs)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#D55E00") +
  labs(
    title = "Barry Bonds' Home Runs by Season",
    x = "Season",
    y = "Home runs"
  )
```
